title: (Update 7) Keyless Auto Dig & Sell | 5x Luck , 16x Detection
features:
PC Users: If the menu doesn't open or features don't work, press F9 and look for [GooldAura] lines. If you see a warning, your executor may not support all features needed. Try a different executor.

**What's New (v3.4.10) — 9/24/2026**

· Free VIP – unlocked automatically at the client level, no gamepass purchase needed.

· The built-in "Default" profile is now protected – it can no longer be overwritten by Save (use Create New Profile instead).

· New island added: Ribcage Reef (Island 8) – fossil reef with the newest gear tier (Marrow → Abyssal).

· New gear tier – 5 new shovels, 5 new detectors, and 5 new spray bottles added for Ribcage Reef.

· Detector Boost sweep pacing raised to 16x – reveals buried items far faster than before.

· Various backend cleanups and minor bug fixes.

**--Default Features--**

· 16x Detection – sweeping runs at 16x the game's default rate for near-instant buried item reveals.
· Free VIP – unlocked automatically.
  (Does NOT unlock the VIP Auto Clicker – it conflicts with Auto Dig.)

· 5x Luck – combined boost applied for better item rarity rolls.
